jobs.title: Practical Trainee (Embedded Software Development & Python) (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
We are looking for a self-driven Practical Trainee to support the development and integration of embedded software solutions for ASIC testing of hearing instruments. In this role, you will work closely with experienced engineers on real-life testing infrastructure challenges, including USB driver integration, embedded software development, hardware communication, and test automation. This traineeship offers hands-on experience in embedded systems and Python development within an innovative industrial environment.

More about the role

As a Practical Trainee in Embedded Software Development & Python, you will support activities such as:

• Familiarizing yourself with the existing ASIC testing infrastructure and hardware setup

• Supporting the integration of a USB to I2C converter chip into a Python-based test framework

• Developing and implementing embedded software components and communication drivers

• Creating Python wrappers and automation scripts for hardware interaction and testing

• Investigating and implementing efficient interrupt handling and power management solutions

• Collaborating with engineers to evaluate alternative technical solutions when required

• Supporting testing, debugging, validation, and documentation of developed software components

• Assisting with synchronization and integration activities between different hardware and software systems

• Optionally supporting CI pipeline integration and test automation improvements

More about you

• Bachelor’s or Master’s student (ongoing or recently completed) in Electrical Engineering, Embedded Systems, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, or a similar field

• Good Python programming skills

• Basic experience with embedded software development and hardware communication

• Understanding of hardware interfaces and communication protocols such as USB or I2C

• Familiarity with C/C++ and Linux or Windows environments is a plus

• Structured, analytical, and proactive way of working

• Fluent communication skills in English and ability to work independently

More about What We Offer

As a leading global hearing care provider headquartered in Switzerland, we foster an inclusive and collaborative culture. We support work-life balance through a flexible hybrid working model and offer strong learning opportunities, individual development plans, and clear growth paths within R&D.

• Hands-on experience with real embedded systems and hardware testing environments

• Coaching and mentorship by experienced engineers

• Exposure to ASIC testing infrastructure and industrial software development processes

• International and multidisciplinary working environment

• Opportunity to work on innovative technologies related to hearing instruments

jobs.title: Global Head of Intellectual Property
jobs.description:
Sonova is a global leader in innovative hearing care solutions, dedicated to improving lives through technology. Intellectual Property is a critical strategic asset that underpins our innovation leadership, competitive differentiation, and long-term business success.

We are seeking a Global Head of Intellectual Property to lead Sonova's global intellectual property strategy and governance framework. This is a highly visible enterprise leadership role operating at the intersection of Legal, R&D, innovation, and business strategy.

The execuitve will serve as the enterprise owner of IP strategy, risk management, enforcement, licensing strategy, and governance across both hard and soft IP. Working in close partnership with R&D leadership, the leader will ensure that intellectual property is fully integrated into technology planning, innovation pipelines, product roadmaps, and business decision-making.

The successful candidate will lead a global IP organization through experienced team leaders and external partners while serving as a trusted advisor to executive leadership on matters that impact innovation, competitive positioning, and enterprise value creation.

Key Responsibilities

Enterprise IP Strategy & Leadership

• Define, develop, and continuously evolve Sonova's global intellectual property strategy, ensuring alignment with corporate objectives, innovation priorities, and market positioning.

• Serve as the principal advisor to the General Counsel, Executive Committee members, R&D leadership, and senior business leaders on intellectual property matters.

• Own enterprise-wide IP governance, risk management, and strategic decision-making across patents, trade secrets, trademarks, copyrights, and related intellectual property assets.

• Lead and develop senior IP professionals while fostering a business-oriented and strategically focused IP culture.

• Shape the future evolution of Sonova's IP function, capabilities, operating model, and external partnerships.

Strategic Partnership with R&D

• Serve as the primary strategic interface between the Legal and R&D organizations on all intellectual property matters.

• Ensure IP strategy is embedded throughout innovation processes, technology planning, product development, and long-term technology roadmaps.

• Maintain a permanent strategic presence within innovation planning and technology governance forums to identify and protect key innovations at the earliest stages of development.

• Guide strategic decisions concerning patents, trade secrets, design rights, publication strategies, open innovation initiatives, and alternative protection mechanisms.

• Partner closely with R&D leadership to ensure effective operation of invention harvesting processes, IP stage-gates, freedom-to-operate reviews, and technical risk assessments.

Portfolio Strategy & Investment Governance

• Establish the strategic direction for Sonova's global patent and design portfolio.

• Ensure portfolio investments are aligned with business priorities, technology trends, and competitive differentiation objectives.

• Oversee portfolio development, prosecution strategy, maintenance decisions, and lifecycle management through experienced internal teams and external counsel.

• Regularly assess portfolio strength, geographic coverage, white-space opportunities, competitive positioning, and emerging risks.

• Drive a disciplined approach to maximizing portfolio value and return on investment.

Competitive Intelligence & Strategic Risk Assessment

• Direct Sonova's IP-based competitive intelligence strategy, ensuring alignment with enterprise priorities and technology objectives.

• Oversee strategic freedom-to-operate, clearance, and risk management frameworks across the organization.

• Translate complex competitive IP landscapes into actionable strategic recommendations for executive leadership.

• Monitor significant industry, regulatory, technological, and competitive developments impacting Sonova's innovation strategy.

• Identify opportunities for portfolio strengthening, strategic acquisitions, partnerships, licensing opportunities, and risk mitigation.

Licensing, Partnerships & Value Creation

• Lead the company's strategy for licensing, cross-licensing, technology partnerships, and other IP-based value creation initiatives.

• Support strategic commercial negotiations where intellectual property is a key business asset.

• Provide strategic IP leadership in M&A transactions, partnerships, collaborations, and technology investments.

• Evaluate opportunities to leverage Sonova's intellectual property portfolio as a competitive and commercial advantage.

Disputes, Enforcement & Litigation Strategy

• Define and direct Sonova's global strategy for IP enforcement, defense, and dispute resolution.

• Oversee significant patent, trademark, copyright, advertising, and technology-related disputes worldwide.

• Manage external counsel and expert advisors supporting contentious IP matters.

• Advise executive leadership on risk exposure, litigation strategy, settlement considerations, and business impacts.

• Ensure alignment between litigation strategy, portfolio development, and broader business objectives.

Governance & Enterprise Risk Management

• Establish and maintain robust IP governance frameworks, policies, processes, and decision-making standards.

• Chair or actively participate in cross-functional governance forums responsible for intellectual property strategy, prioritization, and resource alignment.

• Ensure consistent and proactive management of IP-related risks across jurisdictions and business functions.

• Promote enterprise-wide awareness of intellectual property as a strategic business asset.

• Ensure effective utilization of external counsel, service providers, and supporting resources.

More about you:

• Advanced degree (JD, PhD, LLM, MSc Engineering, or equivalent) in a legal, scientific, engineering, or technical discipline.

• 15+ years of progressive intellectual property experience with significant exposure to patent strategy and counseling.

• Demonstrated success operating at a senior strategic level and influencing executive leadership and R&D organizations.

• Deep understanding of global patent systems and broader intellectual property frameworks.

• Experience leading IP organizations through senior professionals and external partners.

• Strong commercial orientation with the ability to balance legal, technical, business, and innovation considerations.

• Proven experience managing complex cross-functional stakeholder environments.

Preferred previous experience

• Experience within a multinational technology, healthcare, medical device, electronics, software, or innovation-driven organization.

• Significant experience in patent litigation, enforcement, oppositions, or dispute management in the US and Europe.

• Demonstrated success supporting strategic licensing, cross-licensing, technology transactions, collaborations, or M&A activities.

• Familiarity with U.S., European, and Asian intellectual property systems and regulatory environments.

• Experience partnering closely with engineering and R&D organizations in highly innovative environments.

Why Join Sonova

This is a rare opportunity to shape the intellectual property strategy of a global innovation leader operating at the intersection of healthcare and technology.

You will have direct influence on innovation strategy, technology direction, competitive positioning, and enterprise value creation while partnering closely with world-class R&D, legal, and business leaders. The role offers exceptional visibility, meaningful impact, and the opportunity to help define the future of intellectual property at Sonova.

• Valuta regolarmente la forza del portafoglio, la copertura geografica, le opportunità di spazio bianco, il posizionamento competitivo e i rischi emergenti.
• Guidare un approccio disciplinato per massimizzare il valore del portafoglio e il ritorno sugli investimenti. Intelligenza competitiva e valutazione strategica del rischio

• Condurre la strategia dell'azienda per la concessione di licenze, licenze incrociate, partnership tecnologiche e altre iniziative di creazione di valore basate su IP.

• Gestisci consulenti esterni e consulenti esperti che supportano le questioni IP pertinenti.

• Una profonda comprensione dei sistemi di brevetti globali e dei più ampi quadri di proprietà intellettuale.

• Forte orientamento commerciale con la capacità di bilanciare considerazioni legali, tecniche, aziendali e di innovazione.
• Esperienza comprovata che gestisce ambienti di stakeholder interfunzionali complessi. Preferito esperienza precedente
• Esperienza all'interno di una tecnologia multinazionale, assistenza sanitaria, dispositivo medico, elettronica, software o organizzazione orientata all'innovazione.

You'll collaborate with multidisciplinary engineering teams to transform innovative RF concepts into high-performance products. • Design, develop, and optimize PCB antennas and RF circuits from concept through product integration

• Create verification strategies, develop test plans, and perform verification of RF solutions to ensure performance and reliability

• Perform RF simulations and evaluate antenna and transceiver performance using industry-leading simulation tools

• Support the design, development, and verification of next-generation wireless communication platforms

• Lead RF compliance activities, ensuring product conformance with regulatory standards

• Experience designing analog electronic circuits and PCB-based RF solutions

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a structured and solution-oriented mindset

As one of the world's leading hearing care providers headquartered in Switzerland, we're committed to building an inclusive culture. Rather than focusing on operational security, you'll enable engineering teams to build secure products by design, balancing innovation, usability, compliance, and customer trust.

If you have a strong software engineering background and have expanded your expertise into product cybersecurity, this is an opportunity to shape technologies that improve the lives of millions of people worldwide.

More about the role

• Integrate cybersecurity throughout the Secure Software Development Lifecycle (Secure SDLC) for connected medical devices, embedded software, mobile applications, and cloud services.

• Lead threat modeling activities, cybersecurity risk assessments, and mitigation planning together with global R&D teams.

• Partner with software engineering teams to embed security into development workflows, DevSecOps practices, and CI/CD pipelines.

• Coordinate product vulnerability management activities, including assessment, prioritization, remediation tracking, and post-market monitoring.

• Support regulatory submissions and quality processes by preparing cybersecurity documentation and evidence.

• Advise engineering, product management, quality, and regulatory teams on practical, risk-based cybersecurity decisions.

• Promote a security-first mindset by coaching teams, supporting security champions, and driving continuous improvement across R&D.

More about you

Essential

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Engineering, or a related technical discipline (or equivalent practical experience).

• 5+ years of experience in software engineering, software architecture, product development, Secure SDLC, or a comparable software development environment.

• At least 3 years of hands-on experience in product cybersecurity or application security.

• Strong understanding of Secure Software Development Lifecycle (Secure SDLC) and how cybersecurity integrates into modern software development.

• Experience working closely with software development teams throughout the product lifecycle.

• Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain complex security topics to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Professional working proficiency in English.

• Experience developing software for medical devices or other regulated industries.

• Experience with DevSecOps and security integration into CI/CD pipelines.

• Knowledge of cybersecurity standards and regulations such as IEC 81001-5-1, IEC 62304, ISO 14971, MDR, FDA, GDPR, CRA or similar frameworks.

• Security certifications such as CISSP, CSSLP, GIAC, or equivalent.

• Experience with cloud security, cryptography, authentication technologies, or software supply chain security.

• Familiarity with Privacy by Design principles, AI agent security, and AI-supported development environments.

More about what we offer

As one of the world's leading hearing care providers headquartered in Switzerland, we're committed to building an inclusive culture where innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning thrive.

Joining Sonova means working with highly skilled international teams developing technologies that genuinely improve people's quality of life. We offer a flexible hybrid working model, extensive learning and development opportunities, and clear career paths that support both your professional and personal growth.

Here, you'll have the opportunity to shape secure, connected healthcare technologies while working in an environment where your ideas are valued and your impact is visible.

descriptionByLocale.en:
As a Product Cybersecurity Manager , you will play a key role in ensuring cybersecurity is embedded into the development of Sonova's connected hearing solutions—from embedded software and mobile applications to cloud-based services.

Working closely with software engineers, product teams, architects, quality, and regulatory experts, you'll help integrate security into every stage of the product development lifecycle. Rather than focusing on operational security, you'll enable engineering teams to build secure products by design, balancing innovation, usability, compliance, and customer trust.

If you have a strong software engineering background and have expanded your expertise into product cybersecurity, this is an opportunity to shape technologies that improve the lives of millions of people worldwide.

More about the role

• Integrate cybersecurity throughout the Secure Software Development Lifecycle (Secure SDLC) for connected medical devices, embedded software, mobile applications, and cloud services.

• Lead threat modeling activities, cybersecurity risk assessments, and mitigation planning together with global R&D teams.

• Partner with software engineering teams to embed security into development workflows, DevSecOps practices, and CI/CD pipelines.

• Coordinate product vulnerability management activities, including assessment, prioritization, remediation tracking, and post-market monitoring.

• Support regulatory submissions and quality processes by preparing cybersecurity documentation and evidence.

• Advise engineering, product management, quality, and regulatory teams on practical, risk-based cybersecurity decisions.

• Promote a security-first mindset by coaching teams, supporting security champions, and driving continuous improvement across R&D.

More about you

Essential

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Engineering, or a related technical discipline (or equivalent practical experience).

• 5+ years of experience in software engineering, software architecture, product development, Secure SDLC, or a comparable software development environment.

• At least 3 years of hands-on experience in product cybersecurity or application security.

• Strong understanding of Secure Software Development Lifecycle (Secure SDLC) and how cybersecurity integrates into modern software development.

• Experience working closely with software development teams throughout the product lifecycle.

• Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain complex security topics to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Professional working proficiency in English.

Nice to have

• Experience developing software for medical devices or other regulated industries.

• Experience with DevSecOps and security integration into CI/CD pipelines.

• Knowledge of cybersecurity standards and regulations such as IEC 81001-5-1, IEC 62304, ISO 14971, MDR, FDA, GDPR, CRA or similar frameworks.

• Security certifications such as CISSP, CSSLP, GIAC, or equivalent.

• Experience with cloud security, cryptography, authentication technologies, or software supply chain security.

• Familiarity with Privacy by Design principles, AI agent security, and AI-supported development environments.

More about what we offer

As one of the world's leading hearing care providers headquartered in Switzerland, we're committed to building an inclusive culture where innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning thrive.

Joining Sonova means working with highly skilled international teams developing technologies that genuinely improve people's quality of life. We offer a flexible hybrid working model, extensive learning and development opportunities, and clear career paths that support both your professional and personal growth.

Here, you'll have the opportunity to shape secure, connected healthcare technologies while working in an environment where your ideas are valued and your impact is visible.

Als einer der weltweit führenden Anbieter von Hörgeräten mit Hauptsitz in der Schweiz setzen wir uns für den Aufbau einer integrativen Kultur ein, in der Innovation, Zusammenarbeit und kontinuierliches Lernen gedeihen.

In dieser Funktion bist du als Technischer Spezialist Produktion TSP (m/w/d) ein zentraler Bestandteil unseres Support-Teams in der Elektronikfertigung.

jobs.description:
Research & Development delivers hearing solutions and services for people with hearing loss, hearing care professionals, and further related people, in the form of hearing instruments, accessories, web services, mobile applications, and PC software.

As a Power Management Engineer, you will hold a pivotal role in enabling the industry‑leading AI hearing functions that define our next‑generation products. You are the one who ensures that cutting‑edge intelligence is not only possible, but reliably powered every moment. This position sits at the crossroads of multiple technical domains: electronic design, battery innovation, and embedded software, offering a uniquely dynamic environment where your decisions directly shape performance, efficiency, and user experience. It is a role for someone who wants to be at the technological core, driving the energy systems that make advanced hearing AI truly come alive.

.

More about the role

• Design, develop, and optimize battery and power management systems for hearing instruments and charging solutions

• Specify, integrate, and validate power management circuits for rechargeable and non-rechargeable battery systems

• Evaluate, specify, integrate, and optimize Power Management ICs (PMICs) and related power conversion architectures for future hearing instruments and charging systems

• Define and implement battery management algorithms and power strategies, including State of Charge and State of Health estimation, charging behavior, protection mechanisms, and energy optimization

• Collaborate closely with hardware and firmware teams to ensure robust integration of battery and power management functions into the overall hearing instrument and charger architecture

• Develop and validate electrical and system-level models for power consumption, load profiles, and battery behavior under different operating conditions

• Analyze and debug complex power-related system issues, driving root-cause identification and resolution

• Contribute to the continuous improvement of power management platforms, methods, and development processes, and stay informed about emerging technologies and trends

• Evaluate emerging power management technologies and energy management concepts to support future product generations

More about you

• Master’s degree or PhD in Electrical/Electronic Engineering, Microelectronics, or a related field

• Proven experience in the design of power management systems for low-power embedded devices, including DC/DC conversion, load switches, charging circuits, and energy-efficient architectures

• Experience with rechargeable and non-rechargeable battery technologies, as well as a strong understanding of system-level behavior, load profiling, power consumption analysis, and battery aging effects

• Hands-on experience with electrical characterization, laboratory measurements, and data-driven validation of power systems

• Strong programming skills in Python for data analysis, automation, and model development; MATLAB is a plus

• Experience in optimizing ultra-low-power systems under strict energy and size constraints is an asset

• Experience in debugging complex power-related issues in low-power applications and charging systems is an asset

• Structured, proactive, and quality-conscious working style, with the ability to bring forward innovative ideas and collaborate effectively in a distributed, diverse environment

• Fluent in English (spoken and written)

More about what we offer

As one of the world’s leading hearing care providers headquartered in Switzerland, we’re committed to building an inclusive culture. We want to create an environment where you can balance a successful career with your commitments and interests outside of work, through our flexible hybrid working model. We offer a wide range of training opportunities for both your professional and personal development, and there are exceptional growth opportunities with individual development plans.

Employment level 80-100%.

Application process

Magdalena Suszek, Talent Acquisition Partner, is looking forward to receiving your complete application (cover letter, CV, references, and certificates) via our online job application platform.

For this vacancy only direct applications will be considered.

Sonova is seeking a Senior Manager, RIC and BTE Solutions to lead the development and delivery of signal processing solutions across RIC and BTE hearing products. This role provides technical, functional, and people leadership to ensure scalable, high-quality, and product-ready software solutions that support Sonova’s global hearing system platforms.

More about the role

• Lead and own the development, design and integration of signal processing features for Sonova hearing systems

• Provide technical leadership and decision-making authority for signal processing realization

• Drive reuse, scalability, and product readiness across platforms, products, and Sonova brands

• Establish clear cross domain alignment and decision making across departments and areas

• Collaborate closely with Product Management and Project Leaders to ensure customer focus and success in the market

• Lead, develop, and manage a team of software professionals while supporting talent development and succession planning

More about you

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Software Engineering, Systems Engineering, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a closely related technical discipline

• Proven leadership experience in software development and in people leadership within complex R&D environments

• Extensive experience shaping and delivering software features across multiple platforms, product generations, and releases

• Strong understanding of Digital Signal Processing (DSP), system integration, fitting software systems, and regulated product development

• Ability to lead through ambiguity while balancing innovation, scalability, quality, and long-term platform value

• Strong, confident communicator with demonstrated soft skills applied to leadership and collaboration across technical, audiological, and business stakeholders

• Experience working in international, multi-site, and cross-functional environments

• Curious about emerging technologies, particularly AI, with a forward-looking mindset and passion for innovation

• Fluent in English; German is a plus

As one of the world’s leading hearing care providers headquartered in Switzerland, we’re committed to building an inclusive culture. We want to create an environment where you can balance a successful career with your commitments and interests outside of work, through our flexible hybrid working model. We offer a wide range of training opportunities for both your professional and personal development, and there are exceptional growth opportunities with individual development plans.

At Sonova, you'll join a global team of innovators dedicated to transforming lives through cutting-edge hearing technology. You'll have the opportunity to:

• Shape the future of signal processing across multiple global hearing instrument brands.

• Lead talented international engineering teams working on technologies that improve the lives of millions of people worldwide.

• Influence long-term platform strategy and drive innovation in a collaborative, global R&D environment.

• Work with passionate experts in software engineering, signal processing, audiology, and product development.

• Grow your career while making a meaningful impact on the future of hearing healthcare.

jobs.title: Data Scientist (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
More about the role

Join our R&D organization and help build a deep understanding of how our products are used in the real world. This role sits in a technical team and focuses on translating complex product and user data into clear, decision-shaping insights for functional owners, senior leadership and product marketing.

In this role, you will:

• Lead the analysis of product usage data to uncover meaningful patterns, behaviors, and segmentations

• Build a deep understanding of our datasets and apply statistical methods to generate robust, decision-relevant insights

• Translate complex technical findings into clear recommendations that support R&D decisions, product direction, and business priorities

• Communicate usage insights in a simple, credible, and actionable way to technical teams, senior leaders, and product marketing stakeholders

• Create practical analyses and dashboards that make product usage visible and easier to act on

• Partner closely with R&D teams, engineering, product management, senior leaders, and product marketing to frame the right questions and connect data to decisions

• Stay current on relevant developments in analytics, statistics, and AI, and apply them where they improve insight quality and business value

More about you

• Master’s degree or PhD in Psychology, Behavioral Science, Health Science, Audiology, or a related field

• Several years of experience in data science, product analytics, user insights, or a similar role

• Strong expertise in statistics, segmentation, behavioral analysis, and extracting insight from complex real-world datasets

• Strong hands-on skills in Python and dashboarding, with the ability to move between strategic insight generation and practical delivery

• Proven ability to translate deep technical analysis into clear recommendations for both technical and non-technical stakeholders

• Experience working with complex datasets and turning them into clear recommendations for non-technical stakeholders

• Confidence working with R&D and engineering stakeholders while also communicating clearly with senior leaders and product marketing

• Experience in MedTech, healthcare, or another scientific or regulated environment is a plus

• Clear, structured communication and a strong instinct for connecting data to product and business decisions

• Fluent in English

More about what we offer

As one of the world’s leading hearing care providers headquartered in Switzerland, we’re committed to building an inclusive culture. We want to create an environment where you can balance a successful career with your commitments and interests outside of work, through our flexible hybrid working model.

We offer a wide range of training opportunities for both your professional and personal development, and there are exceptional growth opportunities with individual development plans.

jobs.title: Clinical Affairs Manager (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Sonova is seeking a dedicated and detail-oriented Clinical Affairs Manager to support the clinical evaluation of our innovative hearing instrument systems. As a Clinical Affairs Manager, you will play a crucial role in supporting the market access of our medical devices in ensuring compliance with company procedures and applicable clinical regulations. This position requires a strong understanding of clinical data and the ability to summarize relevant clinical evidence effectively according to a pre-defined plan.

More about the role:

• Support clinical evaluations for hearing instruments throughout the product lifecycle—from early product development through market launch and post-market activities—in accordance with Sonova procedures and applicable global regulations.

• Plan and scope clinical evaluations; identify, critically appraise and analyze relevant clinical and scientific data.

• Assess device safety, clinical performance and benefit–risk profile against the current state of the art.

• Create and maintain clinical evaluation documentation in collaboration with cross-functional project teams, including Clinical Evaluation Plans and Reports, Clinical Development Plans, scientific literature search plans and reports, and Post-Market Clinical Follow-up Plan and Reports.

• Support with regulatory guidance for product claims.

• Collaborate closely with Clinical Affairs, Clinical Operations, Audiology Research Centers, R&D, Regulatory Affairs, Quality and Marketing to ensure regulatory compliance, knowledge sharing and continuous process improvement.

More about you:

Must-have:

• A master’s degree or PhD in health sciences, audiology, medicine, biomedical engineering, psychology, life sciences or a related field.

• Experience working with clinical studies or investigations, for example conducting, coordinating or monitoring clinical studies.

• Experience working with clinical data and the ability to critically interpret clinical study results, scientific publications and relevant statistical analyses.

• Experience conducting scientific literature searches using databases such as PubMed, Cochrane or Embase, as well as critically appraising and summarizing the identified evidence.

• Knowledge of relevant clinical and medical-device regulations and standards, such as EU MDR, FDA requirements, GCP or ISO 14155.

• Strong analytical skills and attention to detail.

• Ability to work independently, take ownership and manage responsibilities and deadlines effectively.

• A collaborative, self-motivated approach and the ability to communicate openly and effectively across interdisciplinary teams.

• Fluency in English is required; knowledge of German would be an advantage.

Nice to have

• Hands-on experience conducting Clinical Evaluations in accordance with EU MDR.

• Experience within the medical-device industry.

• Experience with hearing instruments, audiology or another relevant healthcare product area.

• Knowledge of Polarion or a comparable documentation management system.

More about what we offer:

As one of the world’s leading hearing care providers headquartered in Switzerland, we are committed to building an inclusive culture where you can balance a successful career with your life outside of work through our flexible hybrid working model. We offer a wide range of training opportunities for both professional and personal development, with strong growth opportunities supported by individual development plans.

Application process:

Magdalena Suszek, Talent Acquisition Partner, is looking forward to receiving your application via our online job application platform, including your CV and cover letter. For this vacancy, only direct applications will be considered.
